feature: Brief spoken previews, silence pause and microphone readiness
default_build_abis: unchanged; device ABI is opt-in Gradle property
changes: Conversational playback previews at most two sentences or 45 words, with a 600-character safety limit; full text and explicit read-aloud are preserved
No automatic recognizer retry after silence, no-match or errors; silence pauses with an explicit Resume mic action
A completed recognition attempt is destroyed without a redundant cancel
Preparing microphone is distinct from actual listening readiness; startup has a bounded timeout
Stale recognition callbacks cannot submit, unmute or restart capture; playback completion still waits for the original host turn to finish
device_gate: Passed: 2 scripted S22 engine tests; 0.035 seconds
acoustic_beep_verification: Pending; provider-owned normal start/end tones may remain. No system volume suppression or provider switching.
host_speech_and_native_realtime: Remain disabled by existing rollout gates
plugin_protocol: Unchanged; no mobile tool or broker behavior changes
limitations: This is still foreground half-duplex voice; it is not native realtime audio.
Short spoken previews do not reduce the host model generation time or change the full written answer.
After silence, recognition stays paused until Resume mic; it does not repeatedly reopen capture.
Real microphone recognition, acoustic tones and spoken end-to-end conversation are not claimed as verified.
device_checks: Production engine and spoken-preview adapter with scripted input/output on Android; no microphone, speaker playback, host prompt or UI gestures
